scenarioPlan.name: Draft create and reload
prerequisites: Authorized user with Sales Orders access
expectedUi: Select the linked customer and product in the Sales Order form
Save the draft and reopen it after a browser reload
expectedEffects: One draft with the selected customer and one line is persisted
No payment transaction or inventory movement is created
assertions: Order, line quantity, total, customer, and product match the prepared dimensions
Inventory and payment baselines are unchanged
cleanupRequirements: Delete run-owned draft orders through the Atlas order service and verify their soft-delete state in Supabase.
Delete only the run-owned product and customer after dependent orders are cleaned.
Retire storage only when this run created it, ownership is proven, and no active products depend on it.

scenarioPlan.name: Draft edit and reload
prerequisites: Authorized user with Sales Orders access
expectedUi: Create a draft in the form
Edit its quantity, save, and reload the existing order
expectedEffects: The original order ID remains stable
The persisted line quantity and total reflect the saved edit
assertions: Exactly one order exists for the scenario marker
The same order ID has quantity 2 and the matching total after reload
No payment or inventory side effects are recorded
cleanupRequirements: Delete run-owned draft orders through the Atlas order service and verify their soft-delete state in Supabase.
Delete only the run-owned product and customer after dependent orders are cleaned.
Retire storage only when this run created it, ownership is proven, and no active products depend on it.

scenarioPlan.name: Draft cancellation
prerequisites: Authorized user with Sales Orders management permission
expectedUi: Cancel it from the Sales Orders list and confirm in the application dialog
expectedEffects: The existing order transitions from draft to cancelled
No payment or stock movement is posted
assertions: The order retains its ID and becomes cancelled
Inventory and payment baselines remain unchanged
cleanupRequirements: Delete run-owned draft orders through the Atlas order service and verify their soft-delete state in Supabase.

hybridBoundaries.browser: Real Atlas UI in Playwright; authenticated with the configured ordinary live-test account.
hybridBoundaries.supabase: Verified directly through an authenticated Supabase client using that ordinary account and workspace RLS.
hybridBoundaries.dexie: The application Dexie order cache is read independently in the authenticated browser after save and reload.
hybridBoundaries.nativeSqlite: Not exercised by this browser runner; SQLite mirroring is unverified.
hybridBoundaries.desktopRuntime: Electron/Tauri desktop runtime and restart recovery are not exercised.
